helpPage.title: Frequently asked questions
helpPage.subtitle: Common questions about joining, pricing, and how contact details unlock.

faq.question: Do I need an account to browse teachers and classes?
faq.answer: No — anyone can search and view profiles without signing in. You'll need a free account to join a teacher or class, view notes, or take exams.

faq.question: Why is the teacher's name and phone number hidden?
faq.answer: Full names and phone numbers only unlock once you've actually joined that specific teacher or class. This protects teachers from spam and keeps contact requests genuine.

faq.question: How does pricing work if a class has multiple teachers?
faq.answer: If you join a specific teacher inside a class, you pay that teacher's own rate. If you join the class generally, you pay the class's rate.

faq.question: Is ClassPortals free to join?
faq.answer: Yes — the Free plan covers a basic listing for teachers and classes. Paid plans add featured placement and a larger ad slot.

faq.question: Can I advertise without creating a full profile?
faq.answer: Yes — the Advertise page lets you post a standalone ad (Basic, Featured, or Homepage Spotlight) without setting up an ongoing teacher or class profile.

faq.question: How do online classes work?
faq.answer: Teachers schedule a class and share their own Zoom or Google Meet link. The "Join Live Class" button activates once the class is about to start.

faq.question: Can I download or print notes?
faq.answer: No — notes are view-only and watermarked with your name to protect the teacher's content. This applies to every note across the platform.
